title: Japan University Application and Scholarship Roadmap + Live Q&A
description: Planning to study in Japan but unsure which university, intake, scholarship route, or application process fits your profile? Join Japan-based AbroadMates mentors for a practical overview and leave with a shortlist framework, document checklist, and personal application timeline.
mentorHeading: Learn from someone who has already done it.
mentorBio: Mayesha Maliha Proma secured a 100% tuition reduction scholarship in Japan. During her own application journey, she navigated university selection, scholarship planning, document preparation, and the challenges of applying without a clear roadmap.

In this session, Mayesha will share the strategies, lessons, and practical steps that helped her build a successful Japan university application. From choosing the right universities to understanding scholarship opportunities, she will help students approach the process with more clarity and confidence.
outcomesHeading: After 100 minutes, you will have a clearer plan
outcomesIntro: In 100 minutes, you’ll get practical insights from real students who have gone through the Japan study journey. From university selection and scholarships to applications and preparation, you’ll leave with a clearer direction for your own path.

outcomes.title: How to choose the right university, program, and study route in Japan
Understanding Japan’s master’s admission process and application requirements
Preparing essential documents, statements of purpose, and research proposals
How to approach professors and build a stronger application profile
Exploring MEXT, JASSO, university scholarships, and other funding opportunities
Creating a realistic budget for tuition, living expenses, and studying in Japan
Understanding student visa, housing, healthcare, and daily life preparation
Building your personal 30-day action plan to start your Japan study journey

roadmapIntro: 3 segments and live Q&A — every minute mapped to a decision you will face.
